facts.fact: NITA-U states that Phase 5 of the National Backbone Infrastructure, launched nationally in Moroto District on 4 December 2024, was extended to Kanungu District in December 2025, as one of 63 districts in a programme laying over 5,000 km of new optical fibre and 21 solar-powered transmission sites.
